description: A four-panel composite figure in two rows, labelled DP1000–5 (a, green frame) and DP1000–5-TD (b, orange frame), combining scanning electron micrographs with EBSD phase maps of the same regions. (a1) is a secondary-electron SEM image (scale bar 20 µm) with an orientation inset (ND up, TD left, RD right) and three annotated arrows: orange "Crack nucleation" and "Crack deflection" on a kinked crack, and a green "Crack propagation" arrow following the crack; rounded ferrite grains and smoother elongated bands are visible. (a2) is the matching EBSD phase map, colour-coded light blue = FCC and red = BCC (legend at bottom right of (b2)), showing a dark unindexed crack trace flanked by elongated red BCC δ-ferrite bands. (b1) is a lower-magnification SEM image of DP1000–5-TD (scale bar 50 µm) whose inset gives vertical/horizontal orientation arrows (ND, RD) plus a TD label; horizontal bands and cracks run along RD, annotated "Crack nucleation" (orange) and "Crack propagation" (green). (b2) is its EBSD phase map: horizontally elongated red BCC bands in a light-blue FCC austenite matrix, with dark cracks following the bands and linking them. Taken together the panels show that crack nucleation sites, deflection and the resulting crack path follow the δ-ferrite bands whose orientation relative to the tensile axis differs between the two conditions.

subfigures.description: Secondary-electron SEM micrograph of DP1000–5 with a 20 µm scale bar and orientation inset (ND up, TD left, RD right). Orange arrows labelled 'Crack nucleation' and 'Crack deflection' point at a kinked crack, and a green arrow labelled 'Crack propagation' marks the crack path across a surface of rounded ferrite grains and smoother elongated bands.

EBSD phase map of the same DP1000–5 area, colour-coded light blue = FCC (austenite) and red = BCC (ferrite), using the legend given in (b2). A dark unindexed crack trace runs through the map with elongated red BCC bands beside/along it; small bright particles are scattered through the mapped area.

Lower-magnification secondary-electron SEM micrograph of DP1000–5-TD with a 50 µm scale bar and an orientation inset (vertical and horizontal arrows, ND and RD, plus a TD label). Elongated bands run horizontally along RD and are annotated with orange 'Crack nucleation' and green 'Crack propagation' arrows.

EBSD phase map of DP1000–5-TD: horizontally elongated red BCC (δ ferrite) bands lying along RD in a light-blue FCC austenite matrix. Dark crack traces follow the red bands and one trace runs across/linking bands; scattered white particles are present. Legend: light blue = FCC, red = BCC.

observations.observation: The figure is a four-panel composite: two SEM micrographs ((a1), (b1)) and two EBSD phase maps ((a2), (b2)), arranged as row (a) for DP1000–5 and row (b) for DP1000–5-TD, with the condition names printed vertically along the left edges.
Panel (a1) carries a scale bar of 20 µm and an orientation inset with ND pointing up, TD pointing left and RD pointing right.
Panel (a1) is annotated with orange arrows labelled 'Crack nucleation' and 'Crack deflection' and a green arrow labelled 'Crack propagation'.

Panel (b1) is a lower-magnification SEM image (scale bar 50 µm) than (a1) (20 µm), and shows elongated bands running horizontally (parallel to the RD arrow) with orange 'Crack nucleation' and green 'Crack propagation' annotations.
In both EBSD phase maps the colour legend is light blue = FCC and red = BCC, with red BCC forming elongated bands and light blue FCC filling the matrix between them.
Dark, unindexed crack traces in (a2) pass through the mapped area adjacent to red BCC ferrite bands, and in (b2) the crack traces run along the red bands and link adjacent bands.
The caption states that FCC and BCC correspond to austenite and ferrite, respectively.
The caption states that TD, RD and ND represent the transverse, rolling and normal direction, respectively.
The citing text states that a tensile crack in DP1000–5 nucleated at the α/γ interface, propagated along ND, and was deflected to propagate along RD when it met a δ ferrite band parallel to RD.

The citing text states that in DP1000–5-TD the δ/γ interfaces are perpendicular to the tensile direction, so cracks also initiated at these interfaces and connected across the full thickness, causing poor ductility.
No numeric mechanical property values (yield strength, tensile strength, total elongation) are printed anywhere in this figure; only the scale bars 20 µm and 50 µm are given as numbers.
Numerous small bright/white particles are scattered within the EBSD maps of both conditions; the figure gives no label or identification for them.

measured_quantities: SEM scale bar length (µm): 20 µm in (a1), 50 µm in (b1)
phase identity of indexed regions (FCC austenite / BCC ferrite) from EBSD phase maps
unreadable_items: panel (b1): the exact mapping of the arrows in the orientation inset (which of TD/ND is the vertical arrow) is only partially legible; the printed ND and RD labels and a TD label are visible but their arrow assignment cannot be fully resolved
panels (a2) and (b2): EBSD maps are rendered small, so individual grain boundaries and the precise crack path at the band scale cannot be traced reliably; no phase-fraction values are printed
the identity/nature of the small white particles in the EBSD maps is not stated or legible
